source.label: Steam Community Hub / official update path

sources.claim: The official feedback announcement lists v0.4.12, v0.4.17, and v0.4.19 as released paths and separates future improvements as planned work.
The official v0.4.19 note changes high-difficulty drop handling and the weight of listed items including Clay.
The official v0.4.17 note corrects displayed Research tiers among other changes.

changes.summary: Keep the v0.4.19 high-difficulty drop and weight changes visible in the affected routes.

evidence.claim: The official v0.4.19 note removes the item-drop quantity penalty on Very Hard and Devastation Management and reduces the weight of listed items including Clay.

changes.fact: The official note removes the item-drop quantity penalty on Very Hard and Devastation Management.
changes.impact: High-difficulty collection context changes; this does not prove a new Clay enemy, floor, or quantity route.

changes.summary: Keep Clay carry context version-sensitive after the official weight change.

evidence.claim: The official v0.4.19 note lists Clay among items with reduced weight.

changes.fact: The official note reduces the weight of armor, helmets, bones, stone, clay, and other listed items.
changes.impact: Clay carry context is lighter in the updated build; the guide keeps route and quantity claims version-sensitive.

changes.summary: Keep the Research checklist tied to the visible current-build label and tier.

evidence.claim: The official v0.4.17 note corrects displayed Research tiers for Carapace Processing among other changes.

changes.fact: The official note corrects the displayed Research tier for Carapace Processing among other Research display changes.
changes.impact: The Research checklist now asks visitors to copy the visible label and tier and does not infer a hidden prerequisite or order.

changes.summary: Record the feedback status and keep planned work separate from released mechanics.

evidence.claim: The official feedback announcement lists v0.4.12, v0.4.17, and v0.4.19 as released paths and describes later improvements as still being reviewed.

changes.fact: The official feedback announcement says three updates shipped during the first three days of Early Access, links v0.4.12, v0.4.17, and v0.4.19, and lists further improvements still under review.
changes.impact: Keep v0.4.19 as the current numbered boundary; treat the listed future work as pending and do not add a new Clay route, quantity, or Research prerequisite.

unknowns.fact: No direct Clay route, enemy, floor, quantity, or fixed Research prerequisite is stated in the reviewed official update notes.
unknowns.impact: The Prima Clay report remains a dated secondary observation. A separate S008 snapshot covers the current-build Research rows, while future-build behavior and universal order remain unverified.
